name: Long Sơn Pagoda
kicker: The seated white Buddha above the pagoda
summary: The white seated Buddha is the figure you come up to see. The provincial digital guide prints 07:00–17:30 at 22 đường 23 tháng 10 and gives no ticket. Citing Báo Khánh Hòa, it prints 24 m from the ground, 21 m from the base, a 10 m lotus, and a 14 m statue. Vietnam Tourism prints 78 feet. Both height sets stay.
getThere: 22 đường 23 tháng 10. Minutes from the beach were not printed.
heroCaption: The seated white Buddha on the lotus pedestal
body: The provincial digital guide also calls Long Sơn the White Buddha Pagoda and Đăng Long tự. The address is 22 đường 23 tháng 10. Older records there say phường Phương Sơn. Newer administrative wording mentions phường Tây Nha Trang. Both ward names stay. Hours are 07:00–17:30. A ticket is not printed.

The provincial digital guide, citing Báo Khánh Hòa, gives 24 m from the ground, 21 m from the base, a lotus pedestal 10 m wide, and the statue itself 14 m. Vietnam Tourism prints a 78-foot Buddha. Those are different numbers, and both stay. Minutes from Trần Phú were not printed.
